answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The practical consequence is a steady economy where reputation is earned slowly, spent carefully, and never inflated by a sudden influx of cheap accounts.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a wander as the anchor of the cost. A summit stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a ivory holds the rep...
